name: system-health-check
description: Check disk space, memory and CPU load on the machine OpenClaw runs on, list the biggest memory users, and alert when a limit is crossed (or recovers).

disks.description: Comma-separated mount points to check, e.g. '/, /Volumes/Data'

disk_pct.description: Alert when a disk is fuller than this percentage

memory_pct.description: Alert when memory in use is above this percentage

load_per_cpu.description: Alert when the 5-minute load average per CPU core is above this

state_key.description: Where the last alert state is remembered

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for alerts (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const { execFileSync } = require("child_process"); const out = []; for (const mount of process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_DISKS.split(",").map(d => d.trim()).filter(Boolean)) { try { const line = execFileSync("df", ["-kP", mount], { encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] }).trim().split("\n").pop().split(/\s+/); const total = Number(line[1]), used = Number(line[2]), avail = Number(line[3]); out.push({ mount, totalGb: Math.round(total / 1048576 * 10) / 10, freeGb: Math.round(avail / 1048576 * 10) / 10, usedPct: Math.round(used / (used + avail) * 1000) / 10 }) } catch (e) { out.push({ mount, error: "not found" }) } } console.log(JSON.stringify(out))'

node -e 'const os = require("os"); const total = os.totalmem(); let available = os.freemem(); if (os.platform() === "darwin") { try { const vm = require("child_process").execFileSync("vm_stat", { encoding: "utf8" }); const page = Number((vm.match(/page size of (\d+)/) || [])[1] || 4096); const pages = k => Number((vm.match(new RegExp("Pages " + k + ":\\s+(\\d+)")) || [])[1] || 0); available = (pages("free") + pages("inactive") + pages("speculative") + pages("purgeable")) * page } catch (e) {} } const cpus = os.cpus().length; const load = os.loadavg(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ totalGb: Math.round(total / 1073741824 * 10) / 10, usedPct: Math.round((1 - available / total) * 1000) / 10, cpus, load5: Math.round(load[1] * 100) / 100, loadPerCpu: Math.round(load[1] / cpus * 100) / 100, uptimeDays: Math.round(os.uptime() / 86400 * 10) / 10 }))'

ps -A -o rss=,comm= | sort -rn | head -5 | node -e 'const rows = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8").trim().split("\n").filter(Boolean).map(l => { const m = l.trim().match(/^(\d+)\s+(.*)$/); return { mb: Math.round(Number(m[1]) / 1024), name: m[2].split("/").pop() } }); console.log(JSON.stringify(rows))'

node -e 'const disks = JSON.parse(process.env.DISKS); const mem = JSON.parse(process.env.MEM); const top = JSON.parse(process.env.TOP); const L = k => Number(process.env["LOBSTER_ARG_" + k]); const problems = []; disks.forEach(d => { if (!d.error && d.usedPct > L("DISK_PCT")) problems.push({ key: "disk " + d.mount, text: "disk " + d.mount + " is " + d.usedPct + "% full (" + d.freeGb + " GB free)" }) }); if (mem.usedPct > L("MEMORY_PCT")) problems.push({ key: "memory", text: "memory is " + mem.usedPct + "% used" }); if (mem.loadPerCpu > L("LOAD_PER_CPU")) problems.push({ key: "cpu", text: "CPU load is " + mem.loadPerCpu + " per core" }); const lines = ["💾 Disks: " + disks.map(d => d.error ? d.mount + " (not found)" : d.mount + " " + d.usedPct + "% used, " + d.freeGb + " GB free").join("; "), "🧠 Memory: " + mem.usedPct + "% of " + mem.totalGb + " GB used", "⚙️ Load (5 min): " + mem.load5 + " on " + mem.cpus + " cores (" + mem.loadPerCpu + " per core)", "🔝 Top memory: " + top.map(p => p.name + " " + p.mb + " MB").join(", ")]; console.log(JSON.stringify({ healthy: problems.length === 0, problems, report: lines.join("\n"), snapshot: { problems: problems.map(p => p.key).sort() } }))'

node -e 'const c = JSON.parse(process.env.CHECK); const raw = JSON.parse(process.env.DIFF); const d = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw; const before = (d.before && d.before.problems) || []; const after = (d.after && d.after.problems) || []; const fresh = c.problems.filter(p => !before.includes(p.key)); const fixed = before.filter(p => !after.includes(p)); const lines = []; fresh.forEach(p => lines.push("🔴 " + p.text)); fixed.forEach(p => lines.push("✅ OK again: " + p)); lines.push(c.healthy ? "All checks within limits." : "Still over the limit: " + c.problems.length + " check(s)."); console.log(JSON.stringify({ alert: fresh.length + fixed.length > 0, message: lines.join("
") + "

" + c.report }))'
if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
